evals.prompt: The coordinator architecture pitch PNG is exported but still looks basic. Take it through the full publication-quality iteration workflow.
evals.expected_output: At least four post-pitch passes, with pass 1 meeting the 9x meaningful XML gate and passes 2-4 limited to orientation, overlap, and arrow corrections.
expectations: The pitch itself is not counted as one of the four required passes.
Pass 1 compares meaningful non-whitespace XML excluding comments and embedded image data.
Pass 1 rejects invisible padding and reaches at least 9x the pitch count.
Every pass saves a distinct draw.io source, PNG, and short change record.
Every newly exported PNG is actually inspected at A5 print size and enlarged detail.

evals.prompt: Fix overlapping labels and several backwards connectors in docs/diagrams/src/canonical-coordinator-architecture.drawio. It already completed the visual-upgrade pass.
evals.expected_output: Correction-only passes that preserve the visual design, trace connectors, save per-pass artifacts, and continue beyond pass 4 if defects remain.
expectations: No new content or visual redesign is introduced after pass 1.
Direction, endpoints, routing, labels, crossings, and logical junctions are checked.
Native symbols and Agentweaver-specific custom components remain explicitly distinguished.
The workflow continues with correction-only passes when defects remain.

evals.prompt: Create a brand-new architecture diagram explaining Agentweaver memory.
evals.expected_output: The iteration skill should defer to docs-diagram-pitch for initial research and creation.
expectations: The skill description excludes brand-new diagram pitches.

evals.prompt: Please update the React Flow diagram renderer so labels wrap differently.
evals.expected_output: The docs-diagram-iterate skill should not trigger because this is renderer implementation work, not draw.io artifact refinement.
expectations: The trigger description is scoped to existing draw.io artifacts.

evals.prompt: Refine only the queued deep-dive diagrams named in the catalog manifest. Other agents are working on guide and reference diagrams in separate worktrees.
evals.expected_output: A name/area-selected batch that preserves stable output paths and does not touch diagrams owned by other workstreams.
expectations: The selection is limited by owner area and queued status.
Each selected diagram is passed to the renderer by canonical name.
No source, output, review directory, or inventory entry is shared between active writers.
